identity_model: fixed per process; synthetic header; no authentication claim or in-page identity switch

response.user_id: positive integer from validated server configuration

manual_refresh: invalidate epoch; clear rows; reload options; preserve previous selection only if still assigned then refetch its requests

error_rules.401: clear options/selection/rows; review identity unavailable; Refresh retries bootstrap/options
error_rules.404_selected: clear options/selection/rows; community unavailable; Refresh reloads options
error_rules.options_500_network_invalid_timeout: clear options/selection/rows; unable to load communities; manual Refresh
error_rules.requests_500_network_invalid_timeout: clear rows; keep selected label for error context; manual Refresh

response_guard: request epoch and selected ID must still match; abort previous fetch; validate entire response before DOM update
cache: no-store on UI/session/assets and fetch requests; no web storage/cookies/service worker
safe_rendering: textContent/DOM APIs, no API text through innerHTML, no remote assets
lifecycle: pagehide clears rows/options and invalidates requests; pageshow bootstrap resets selection
visible_revocation_limit: fresh checks only; no instant revocation or cancellation of already authorized in-flight network delivery guarantee
